in_marathi.name: Vasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dwelling, Abode, Residence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Vasu is a class of deities associated with the earth and protectors of the universe. Vasus are the guardians of the elements and preside over various natural phenomena. They are also revered as the protectors of houses and homes.

vedic_reference.note: Vasus are 84 divine beings in Hindu mythology, also called Vasus or Vasu-sahasranama. They are considered the guardians of various natural elements like earth, water, air, and fire. In the Rigveda, the hymn to Vasus mentions them as the 'shining ones' or 'luminous ones'.
